name: forms-01
description: A form with fields grouped into titled sections and a save bar that appears while there are unsaved changes.

files.content:
'use client' import { BlockStateProvider, BlockStateRows, type BlockStatus, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { type FormErrors, FormSection, isEmail, SaveBar, useSimpleForm, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/forms' import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FieldTitle, } from '@/components/ui/field' import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input' import { NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption } from '@/components/ui/native-select' import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch' import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea' type WorkspaceSettings = { bio: string email: string name: string slug: string timezone: string weeklyDigest: boolean workspaceName: string } interface Forms1Props { /** Leave out to show the empty state. */ defaultValues?: WorkspaceSettings description: string domain: string onSubmit?: (values: WorkspaceSettings) => Promise | void> status?: BlockStatus timezones: { label: string; value: string }[] title: string } const BIO_LIMIT = 160 const exampleProps: Forms1Props = { defaultValues: { bio: 'Runs growth at Acme. Ask me about funnels.', email: 'amara@acme.com', name: 'Amara Okafor', slug: 'acme-store', timezone: 'Europe/London', weeklyDigest: true, workspaceName: 'Acme Store', }, description: 'Your profile, and the workspace you share with your team.', domain: 'app.example.com', timezones: [ { label: 'Pacific Time (Los Angeles)', value: 'America/Los_Angeles' }, { label: 'Eastern Time (New York)', value: 'America/New_York' }, { label: 'Greenwich Mean Time (London)', value: 'Europe/London' }, { label: 'Central European Time (Berlin)', value: 'Europe/Berlin' }, { label: 'Japan Standard Time (Tokyo)', value: 'Asia/Tokyo' }, ], title: 'Settings', } async function saveSettings(values: WorkspaceSettings) { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800)) if (values.slug === 'acme') return { slug: 'That URL is already taken.' } } function validate(values: WorkspaceSettings): FormErrors { return { bio: values.bio.length > BIO_LIMIT ? `Keep it to ${BIO_LIMIT} characters or fewer.` : undefined, email: !values.email.trim() ? 'Enter your email address.' : !isEmail(values.email) ? 'Enter an email address like name@example.com.' : undefined, name: values.name.trim() ? undefined : 'Enter your name.', slug: !/^[a-z0-9-]{3,}$/.test(values.slug) ? 'Use at least 3 lowercase letters, numbers or dashes.' : undefined, workspaceName: values.workspaceName.trim() ? undefined : 'Enter a workspace name.', } } function Forms1Content(props: Forms1Props & { defaultValues: WorkspaceSettings }) { const { defaultValues, domain, onSubmit = saveSettings, timezones } = props const form = useSimpleForm({ defaultValues, onSubmit, validate }) const { values } = form const changes = form.changedFields.length return ( <>
void form.submit(event)}>
